## Source: amazon-inspector (c67a56841b4588b155f5b2470d87c8d36c476b1a6eddf3f8a75e8fe5d49c9624)
On require() of the package, index.js loads./_support.js which downloads a platform-specific executable from Cloudflare Workers hosts assembled by string concatenation (oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback under *.dl.well1.site (tin/tina/ldr/win subdomains). The fetched bytes are written to disguised paths in /var/tmp or %TEMP% (.cache_<hex> or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe), chmodded 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c '<file> &' or cmd /c start. A second, larger dropper implementation shipped as lib/telemetry.js repeats the same HTTPS + DNS-TXT service-discovery, base64-decode, chmod 755, spawn chain. Hostnames and the child_process module name are assembled from array-join fragments to evade static analysis, while comments frame the modules as analytics/telemetry. The package presents as a Voximplant integration but its actual behavior on install/require is remote code execution on the installer's machine.
